RFC 9990

Example Message Semantics

Abstract

This synthetic document describes how a message carries a measured value together with its unit and date. It exists to test document extraction and is not a real specification.

Status of This Memo

This is a synthetic Standards Track document, written only as a test fixture for document headers.

▲

Table of Contents

  • 1. Introduction

  • 2. Conformance

  • 3. Terminology

1. Introduction

1.1. Details

Section 1 paragraph 1 on introduction: a recipient MUST keep the declared unit and the observation date together when it forwards a measured value, and SHOULD say which party supplied it.

Section 1 paragraph 2 on introduction: a recipient MUST keep the declared unit and the observation date together when it forwards a measured value, and SHOULD say which party supplied it.

Section 1 paragraph 3 on introduction: a recipient MUST keep the declared unit and the observation date together when it forwards a measured value, and SHOULD say which party supplied it.
